t1areplay.note: engineering premise: this study's wrapper and subclass replay T1a's 50-step preflight bit for bit

t0p.note: ladder L-assoc (same deployment inputs, unconstrained router): T1a with S45-SM's state-free association -- the frozen 1.6 M T0P surface router's face routes, PFA (no ray casting); T0P at test (over budget)

gt.note: ladder L-assoc oracle (label-assisted diagnostic bound): T1a with the XAG label face routes through PFA

gtf.note: ladder L-repr oracle (label-assisted diagnostic bound): T1a's ray association unchanged; every event's label surface location (rest-template point, cm + valid flag) appended to its node feature before phi

dz.note: ladder L-obs: T1a with S45-AT dz's depth-scale augmentation (zn out of the training range was S45-LOC's single-step cause)

t0ps16.note: budget: t0p with the readout's slot width 32 -> 16 (354,243 parameters), the room for a 137k test router

t0pnoeg.note: budget: t0p without T1a's event graph (S45's token7 records): what the event graph adds once the association is state-free

t0pnoeg20.note: budget: t0pnoeg with the readout's slot width 32 -> 20 (353,999 parameters)

t0p_srdwa.note: T1a trunk trained on T0P routes, 137k router at test (over budget: 631,614)

t0p_srpa.note: router dose-response on the t0p trunk (over budget)

t0p_sr1.note: router dose-response on the t0p trunk (over budget)

t0ps16_srdwa.note: in-budget candidate A: event graph kept, readout 16, srdwkda (491,534 parameters)

t0pnoeg_srdwa.note: S45 trunk on T0P routes + srdwkda (596,350, over budget; S45-SM xt0_srdwa without dz)

t0pnoeg20_srdwa.note: in-budget candidate B: event graph dropped, readout 20, srdwkda (491,290 parameters)

gt_srdwa.note: label-trained T1a trunk with a deployable router (exposure bias, descriptive)

gt_t0p.note: label-trained T1a trunk with T0P (exposure bias, descriptive)
